The course map

Build understanding,
one decision at a time.

Sessions 01–05 are open. Each session brings together its study guide, lab, visual references, slides, and audio.

SESSION 01 · M00 / M01

Ask a question worth answering

Turn a broad concern into an evidence question, define what each row represents, and make the next decision explicit.

Study, explore & practice →SESSION 02 · M01 / M02

Give every measure a contract

Choose a valid measure, keep denominators visible, and match the display to the variable and question.

Study, explore & practice →SESSION 03 · M02

Read the shape of the evidence

Audit records, compare center and spread, and explore how unusual observations change a summary.

Study, explore & practice →SESSION 04 · M03

Make decisions under uncertainty

Distinguish joint from conditional probability, compare payoffs across states, and inspect risk alongside averages.

Study, explore & practice →SESSION 05 · M04

Put uncertainty around the estimate

Separate individual variability from estimate variability, audit sampling, and interpret confidence correctly.

Study, explore & practice →
